title: PgWire catalog metadata readiness for JDBC benchmark adapters
scope: Move PgWire readiness beyond raw protocol flow into PostgreSQL catalog metadata probes used by JDBC, BenchBase, pgbench, and benchmark adapters.
target_areas: simple and extended PgWire metadata execution paths
constraints: Do not claim full JDBC or official benchmark compatibility from catalog smoke alone
Keep metadata implementation minimal and driven by known benchmark adapter probes
Do not weaken production benchmark gate thresholds or allowlists

steps.step: Add PgWire virtual metadata query handling in FusionDB
Validate release FusionDB against catalog smoke
Run Rust PgWire integration tests and static checks

database_changes: PgWire simple query and extended execute paths can serve selected PostgreSQL metadata queries without falling through to the normal SQL executor.
Virtual metadata currently covers scalar functions, information_schema.tables, information_schema.columns, pg_catalog.pg_type, pg_catalog.pg_namespace, and pg_catalog.pg_class.
Metadata rows are derived from FusionDB table schema entries under schema:* where applicable.
benchmark_changes: pgwire_smoke.py now checks 13 steps including catalog probes.
tests: python -m py_compile pgwire_smoke.py fusiondb_bench.py bench_repeat.py bench_stability.py bench_gate.py fusiondb_matrix.py external_smoke.py external_bootstrap.py
